videos.title: Jan Sluníčko – Stimmungsbilder, Op.92: Elfenreigen & Abend | Chamber Music for Four Violins | PACO
videos.description:
Enjoy this rare performance of two movements from Stimmungsbilder, Op.92 by Czech composer Jan Sluníčko, written for four violins.
I. Elfenreigen (Dance of the Elves) – playful and lively
III. Abend (Evening) – calm and lyrical

Performed by four girls aged 9–11: Danielle, Sakura, Evelyn, and Emily, members of Palo Alto Chamber Orchestra (PACO)
🎥 Video/Audio Credit: Carol Yang 

This beautiful and lesser-known piece is rarely found online—we hope this performance helps others discover its quiet magic.

#chambermusic #FourViolins #Stimmungsbilder #JanSluníčko #Elfenreigen #Abend #YouthMusicians #StudentPerformance
